st: Why getting married should be like a gym membership (maybe).

sec.t: ff.23.1 Relationships over the last 100 years
sec.p: This beautiful GIF by Flowing Data sums up, in just a few frames, everything we have to say to each other today.
Even though 50% of marriages end in divorce (at least in the United States), many people believe their own marriage has only a 1% chance of failing.

sec.t: ff.23.3 Nobody's having s*x any more
sec.p: 27% of the population under 30 is a virgin. This, apparently, is the figure from a General Social Survey study (via The Washington Post). According to the same survey, one person in three hadn't had sex in the past year (in 2018). With COVID, things hardly got better.
Tinder was supposed to be the solution to being cooped up at home. The problem? It has a Gini index (which measures inequality, traditionally of income) worse than Venezuela's.
